blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Savouge stunned National University-Archipelago Builders in straight sets, 25-18, 25-23, 25-20, to cruise to its fifth consecutive victory in the 2026 Spikers’ Turf Invitational Conference on Sunday at Filoil EcoOil Centre in San Juan. The Spin Doctors, who started the tournament with a 0-2 record, made a statement win by taking down the ‘six-peat’ champion of the UAAP in just 78 minutes. Jared Schnake and Joeven Dela Vega powered Savouge with 15 points apiece. Mark Calado tallied 13 points and 12 excellent receptions, while brothers JP and Martin Bugaoan chipped in seven and five points, respectively. Setter Vince […]...
